reviewer: Codex visual inspection of actual native outputs
status: observed creative showcase; not blanket export approval

items.observation: Stacked LOGO / LAND reads correctly; mint upper line and lilac lower line are clearly separated on an opaque dark green square. Wide exterior margins; subtle raster texture and color variation are visible. Intended HEX values are not pixel certification.

LUMA is readable with four distinct chunky colored letters. Initial a-v1 unexpectedly had transparency; a-v2 restores an opaque cream exterior and counters while preserving the playful shapes. Minor raster variation is visible.
Two bold L forms remain distinguishable in an interlocking arrangement. The crossover has slight generated depth despite a flat-style intent; this is shown as returned, not claimed as perfectly flat.
Exact 고요 is readable below the pebble-and-ripple symbol. Stacked arrangement and generous margins are clear; fine ripple tips are less prominent at small size.
BREAD & BLOOM is spelled correctly with a visible ampersand, scalloped seal and wheat motif. This emblem needs more display space than a single lettermark.
Text-free coral folded form has a strong upward silhouette and an open diagonal channel. The long pointed tips are delicate at very small size.
MISO is spelled correctly; smiling cat, cream cheek and chunky lettering form a clear stacked mascot identity. Whisker detail recedes at icon size.
The exact initials N above L are legible, with a diagonal separating cut and consistent heavy stems. This is a lettermark, not the full NORTHLINE wordmark.

Initial a-v1 omitted the downward ㅜ stem, making the first syllable ambiguous. Native a-v2 adds that stem; selected text now reads 물결 while the wavy lower strokes, palette and spacing remain recognizable.
A clear text-free leaf-and-stem symbol with a folded tip. The returned plant has two lateral leaf pairs, fewer than the concept's three; it remains shown as the actual creative result.
NOVA NOTES reads correctly in strong forward-slanted lettering, with a coral spark inside the first O. The wide format needs enough horizontal space; favicon suitability is not claimed.

The yellow owl has the requested lower-left crop and heavy sleepy eyelids. Cream eye areas introduce a third subject color beyond the requested two-family default; the original is retained without a strict-color pass claim.
The sun/cloud silhouette and three broad rays are recognizable. Rounded overlap is clean; fine raster color variation remains.
Two curved bands and their broad negative-space channel remain distinct. The final gesture is more parallel than nested; it is preserved as a creative candidate.
Exact Hangul 틈 is readable as ㅌ + ㅡ + ㅁ with open internal spaces. The full opaque square is artwork, not a platform icon bundle.
A cloud silhouette with an envelope-like pocket fold and soft matte shading is clear. Depth adds tonal variation; it is not a flat restricted-palette sample.
The seedling and pot use a consistent stepped silhouette. Subtle generated texture is present inside broad regions; this is raster pixel-art styling, not a guaranteed integer-grid sprite.
